faq.a: Most jobs finish within two weeks — complex movements may take a little longer, and the trap is rushing them.

faq.q: Do you work on grandfather clocks?
faq.a: Absolutely. This is not a clock shop, it's a timekeeping philosophy — every piece gets comprehensive care.
